method: Deterministic procedural, seed 90217; periodic fields and wrapped detail drawing.

floor.description: Dark umber forest earth, sparse pine needles, tiny pebbles, broad wet/dry variation.
floor.roughness_guidance: 0.88 dry; 0.73 damp patches; constant 0.84 is a practical default.
floor.normal: OpenGL tangent-space +Y (green up); image row derivative compensated
floor.normal_import: Normal map; sRGB off; Repeat wrap; do not flip green

rock.description: Cool grey rough granite, sparse open angular fractures, old olive moss pockets.
rock.roughness_guidance: 0.83 exposed rock; 0.95 moss; constant 0.86 is a practical default.
rock.normal: OpenGL tangent-space +Y (green up); image row derivative compensated
rock.normal_import: Normal map; sRGB off; Repeat wrap; do not flip green

note: No directional baked light or ambient occlusion. Normal depth represents subtle mm-scale relief. Roughness maps are not included.
